Practised inside/outside (andar/bahar) for containers; still building this skill.
Understood top/bottom and on/under (upar/neeche) in practice and new-situation questions.
Practised near/far (paas/door) by comparing with a reference; some comparisons were correct, but use was not steady yet.
Near/far comparisons were correct later for the bus and train.
end.parentNote: Asha practised position words using objects and reference points. Shaurya used upar/neeche correctly in practice and new-situation questions. Inside/outside is still being built, and paas/door was sometimes mixed up, though later comparisons with the bus and train were correct. At home, place a toy inside or outside a box and ask Shaurya to describe it, then compare two objects as paas or door from a chosen reference.
